summary: Hardened the build.sh Python dependency setup path so the web launcher no longer fails when the installed uv lacks the sync subcommand or when uv sync is unusable in the local environment.
features_completed: build.sh now probes whether uv supports sync before using it.
If uv sync is unsupported or fails, build.sh falls back to the existing .venv or creates one with python3.
The pip fallback bootstraps pip with ensurepip when needed and uses no-build-isolation when setuptools and wheel are already present, preserving prepared/offline-friendly workspaces.
README.md, docs/WEB_APP.md, and CHANGELOG.md now document the uv-or-pip fallback behavior.
commands_run: APPFORGE_SKIP_FRONTEND_BUILD=1 ./build.sh --check -> reproduced pre-fix uv sync failure against sandboxed uv cache
APPFORGE_SKIP_FRONTEND_BUILD=1 ./build.sh --check -> passed after patch by falling back from uv sync to pip editable install

bash -c 'uv() { printf "error: unrecognized subcommand '\''sync'\''\n" >&2; return 2; }; export -f uv; APPFORGE_SKIP_FRONTEND_BUILD=1 ./build.sh --check' -> passed after patch by using the unsupported-uv fallback
decisions: Kept uv sync as the preferred fast path when it is supported and succeeds.
Used a pip editable fallback instead of requiring users to upgrade uv, because the launcher should remain the easy source-start path.
Bootstrapped pip only inside .venv and only when missing, avoiding global Python changes.

Used --no-build-isolation only when setuptools and wheel are already available, so prepared environments avoid network-only build dependency resolution while fresh environments can still use pip's normal isolation path.
known_gaps: A completely fresh pip fallback still needs either network access for missing Python dependencies or a pre-populated package cache.
The first failed ensurepip attempt observed during validation came from two concurrent fallback checks touching the same .venv; final validation was rerun sequentially.

reproduction.reported_failure: [build.sh] Syncing Python dependencies with uv. error: unrecognized subcommand 'sync'
reproduction.local_failure: APPFORGE_SKIP_FRONTEND_BUILD=1 ./build.sh --check failed before the patch because uv sync could not access the local uv cache under sandbox restrictions.
reproduction.simulated_old_uv: A shell-exported uv function returning the same unrecognized-subcommand failure reproduced the user's uv compatibility case.
